crossRefs.note: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.
For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?

The little one will become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation. I, Yahweh, will do this quickly in its time.”

For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”

translations.web: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?
translations.bsb: “Why does the Almighty not reserve times for judgment? Why may those who know Him never see His days?
translations.kjv: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
translations.asv: Why are times not laid up by the Almighty? And why do not they that know him see his days?
